name: Local Video & Folder Playlist Player
author: Nahom Ketema
description:
A powerful video player that lets you open and play an entire folder of local video files directly in your browser.

Features:
- Playlist navigation
- Automatic subtitle detection (.srt & .vtt)
- Customizable caption sizes

To use subtitles: Place the subtitle file in the same folder as the video. The subtitle's filename must start with the video's filename (e.g., 'MyVideo_en.srt' will be matched with 'MyVideo.mp4'). This works for common patterns like 'VideoName_en.srt' or 'VideoName (English).vtt'.

All processing is done locally for privacy and security.
